HIGH COURT OF TRIPURA  AGARTALA  A.B. 21/2025 Sri Sujit Debnath ----Applicant(s)
 Versus The State of Tripura ----Respondent(s)
For Applicant(s) : Mr. S. Sarkar, Sr. Advocate  Mr. KD Singha, Advocate  Mr. M. Saha, Advocate For Respondent(s) : Mr. R. Saha, Addl.
PP  HON'BLE
MR. JUSTICE ARINDAM LODH
Order 12/03/2025 Heard Mr. S. Sarkar, learned senior counsel assisted by Mr. KD Singha and Mr. M. Saha, learned counsel appearing for the applicant.
Also heard Mr. R. Saha, learned Additional PP appearing for respondent-State.

This is an application filed under section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant in connection with East Agartala PS case No. 136 of 2024,
registered under Sections 120B,386,406,420,468, 471 and 34 of the IPC.

As per the prosecution story, one Jayanta Biswas lodged written complaint with the Officer-in-Charge of East Agartala police station alleging inter alia that the applicant and another with the assurance of providing bank loan took came to his house and forcibly took away 19 nos. of blank cheques from his wife and compelled them to sign in an agreement.
It was further alleged that the applicant by putting big amount on the blank cheques on his will started to pressurize him and his wife for making the payment.
It was further alleged that the applicant had issued legal notice upon them due to which his wife has been suffering both mentally and physically.
It was further alleged that the complainant and his wife also filed bail application before the learned trial court but, the same was rejected.
Mr. Sarkar, learned senior counsel appearing for the applicant, has submitted that the applicant is seriously apprehending his arrest since the police officials had raided his houses time and again.
It is further submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated with the instant case.
Learned senior counsel also has submitted that the applicant is totally innocent.
Mr. Saha, learned Additional PP has sought for an accommodation to produce the case diary.
I have perused the case record available as on today.

sentences.text:
Considering the matter in its entirety, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant,
namely, Sujit Debnath, as an interim measure till 18.03.2025.

Accordingly, it is ordered that, in the event of arrest, the applicant, namely, Sujit Debnath, may be released on interim bail till 18.03.2025 on executing a bond of Rs. 50,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
However, the applicant shall appear before the Officer-in-Charge of the concerned PS in compliance with the notice issued under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. upon him.
List the matter on 18.03.2025.
On the next date learned Additional PP shall produce the case diary.
